hints.title: What must be true overall?
hints.body: If the total fuel available is less than the total cost of the whole loop, can any starting station possibly finish? What does the opposite tell you?

hints.title: A failed run eliminates many starts
hints.body: Suppose you start at station `s` and run out of fuel before reaching station `k`. Can any station between `s` and `k` be a valid start?

hints.title: Jump past failures
hints.body: If you run out at station `k`, every station from the current start through `k - 1` also fails, because each had even less fuel entering that stretch. Restart the candidate at `k` and keep going. Track the total balance separately.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
total = 0
balance = 0
candidate = 0
for index from 0 to length(gas) - 1:
    difference = gas[index] - cost[index]
    total += difference
    balance += difference
    if balance < 0:
        candidate = index + 1
        balance = 0
return candidate if total >= 0 else -1
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. Check the total before trusting the candidate.
